name: Battery ETA
description: Shows an estimated time to full charge or time remaining on battery, updated as you check it, so you always know how much runway you have left.

commands.title: Battery status
commands.subtitle: Percent, charging state, and time remaining

name: Brew Outdated
description: Lists every Homebrew formula and cask that's fallen behind its latest version, right from the palette. No terminal, no waiting on `brew outdated` to finish scanning.

commands.title: Outdated Homebrew packages
commands.subtitle: Formulae and casks with updates available

name: Clipboard History
description: Keeps a running list of everything you've copied, so a paste from ten minutes ago is never lost to a stray keystroke. Runs quietly in the background and opens as a searchable list whenever you need it.

commands.title: Clipboard history
commands.subtitle: Browse and copy recent clipboard entries

name: Floating Note
description: A small always-on-top note for whatever you don't want to lose track of mid-task — a phone number, a half-formed thought, a checklist. Stays open above other windows until you close it.

commands.title: Open scratch note
commands.subtitle: Always-on-top scratchpad saved to a local file

name: Focus Toggle
description: Flips macOS Focus / Do Not Disturb on or off with one command, no menu bar hunting. Handy right before a call or a deep-work block.

commands.title: Toggle Focus
commands.subtitle: Switch Do Not Disturb / Focus on or off

name: Keep Awake
description: Keeps the Mac from idle-sleeping and leaves the display on for 15 minutes, an hour, two hours, or until you turn it off. Closing the lid can still sleep. Uses the macOS caffeinate tool already on the machine; no extra download.

commands.title: Keep awake
commands.subtitle: Stop the Mac from idle-sleeping for a while

commands.title: Keep-awake status
commands.subtitle: Whether a keep-awake session is running

name: Mic Mute
description: Mutes or unmutes your input device system-wide with a single command — faster than fumbling for the mute button in whatever call app you're in.

name: Mute All
description: Mutes the microphone and speakers in one shot, then restores the volumes you had. Built for walking into a meeting or stepping away without hunting two separate toggles.

commands.title: Mute all
commands.subtitle: Mute mic and speakers, or restore the previous volumes

name: Open Terminal Here
summary: Open a terminal in the front Finder folder
description: Opens your last-picked terminal app at the folder showing in Finder. Default is Terminal. A chooser for iTerm, Warp, and friends comes later; until then the last picked app is the only switch.

commands.title: Open Terminal here
commands.subtitle: Open the last-picked terminal in the front Finder folder

name: Paste Plain
description: Strips fonts, colors, and formatting from whatever's on your clipboard and pastes it as plain text — no more fighting a document's styles when you paste from a webpage or PDF.

commands.title: Paste as plain text
commands.subtitle: Strip rich text from the clipboard

name: Pomodoro
summary: Start / stop a Pomodoro focus session
description: Runs a standard Pomodoro timer in the background so you can start a focus session and forget about the clock until it's done. Start and stop from the palette, no separate app to babysit.

commands.title: Pomodoro status
commands.subtitle: Time remaining in the current phase

name: Ports
summary: List listening ports and kill by pid
description: Lists every process listening on a local port and lets you kill one by pid right from the results — no more `lsof -i` when a dev server won't release its port.

commands.title: Listening ports
commands.subtitle: List and kill processes on local ports

name: Weather
description: Shows current conditions for a fixed location via Open-Meteo, one command away — no app switch, no ads, no thirty-second load time.

commands.title: Current weather
commands.subtitle: Temperature and conditions for your location

name: World Clock
summary: World clock for a fixed zone list
description: Shows the current time across a fixed list of time zones in one glance — built for scheduling across teams without doing the math by hand.
